scenarios.testName: Capability learning authority consequences and source-family exclusions remain frozen
scenarios.expectedEvidence: Raw Provider Return and Provider Supply Capability remain excluded and private learning state cannot become verified/canonical/public/executing authority

scenarios.testName: Capability Engine owns migrations 0044 through 0047 and persistence boundaries remain database-per-owner
scenarios.expectedEvidence: Runtime Registry, Observation Ledger, Reflection Candidate and Disposition/Profile/Twin persistence remain Capability Engine-owned without cross-service SQL

scenarios.testName: accepted Canon version import is durable, idempotent, conflict-safe and restart-safe
scenarios.expectedEvidence: Exact accepted Canon identity/version lineage replays safely while conflicting payloads and work/AI authority claims fail closed

scenarios.testName: governed source verification preserves exact owner ID/version/fingerprint and fails closed on outage or drift
scenarios.expectedEvidence: Only allowed reviewed source families are contacted and stale/mismatched/down source authority cannot be admitted

scenarios.testName: Observation admission and private Ledger preserve exact provenance, trusted subject attribution and durable replay
scenarios.expectedEvidence: Duplicate/replayed governed sources converge without duplicate Ledger business state and identity/provenance drift fails closed

scenarios.testName: Reflection Candidate generation is versioned, immutable, replay-safe and current-Ledger deterministic
scenarios.expectedEvidence: Same snapshot reuses business state, changed Ledger appends a new candidate version, stale anchors cannot overwrite current evidence

scenarios.testName: exact candidate disposition is idempotent, stale-safe and serializes concurrent conflicts
scenarios.expectedEvidence: Only one exact current candidate disposition becomes authoritative and replay does not duplicate business state

scenarios.testName: private Profile/Twin rebuild deterministically after service/database recreation
scenarios.expectedEvidence: Restart/rebuild preserves exact private Profile/Twin meaning without verified, public or autonomous authority

scenarios.testName: Capability Center derives subject from trusted Principal and redacts cross-Workspace state as private not-found
scenarios.expectedEvidence: Private state cannot be enumerated across Workspace/subject boundaries

scenarios.testName: Gateway derives subject from Core Principal and enforces read/mutation permissions, Origin/CSRF, idempotency and anti-spoofing
scenarios.expectedEvidence: Browser callers cannot supply Workspace/subject/role/permission authority or bypass protected mutation controls

scenarios.testName: Lite Capability Center preserves private non-verified projection and bounded action states
scenarios.expectedEvidence: Private Profile/Twin and candidate UI do not present certification, ranking, verified badge or autonomous authority

scenarios.testName: permanent static gate rejects Playwright interception and in-process Execution source-authority substitution in the M6 acceptance journey
scenarios.expectedEvidence: M6 browser acceptance cannot be made green through page/context routing, route fulfillment or a fabricated in-process Capability Observation source authority; the real Execution runtime and owner route are required

scenarios.testName: desktop direct-URL/reload exact-candidate journey uses real Core/Gateway/Execution/Capability Engine/Lite and separate owner PostgreSQL databases
scenarios.ownerDatabase: Capability Engine plus separate Execution owner PostgreSQL
scenarios.expectedEvidence: Desktop path begins from a durable Execution Evidence Review Decision exposed through the real Execution HTTP owner boundary, then loads private Capability state, dispositions an exact candidate and recovers by reload/direct URL

scenarios.testName: the same zero-interception real-Execution-source journey runs at mobile 390x844
scenarios.ownerDatabase: Capability Engine plus separate Execution owner PostgreSQL
scenarios.expectedEvidence: 390px actionable Capability Center remains usable while traversing the real Execution source boundary, without horizontal overflow or fixture interception

scenarios.testName: critical disposition/Profile/Twin durable suite runs a second cycle against the same owner database
scenarios.requiredMode: same PostgreSQL owner database after first successful cycle
scenarios.expectedEvidence: M6 durable semantics are repeatable without one-shot migration or leaked-state assumptions
